fixture.data: Synthetic integer identities, simplified tables, in-memory PGlite. Non-concurrent index builds. Timing is query execution only; warm-run median, not production performance.

scenarios.name: vendorOrderPage
scenarios.beforeSql: SELECT id,order_number FROM parcels WHERE vendor_id=$1 AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY order_number DESC,id DESC LIMIT 21
scenarios.afterSql: SELECT id,order_number FROM parcels WHERE vendor_id=$1 AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY order_number DESC,id DESC LIMIT 21
scenarios.indexSql: CREATE INDEX candidate_vendor_order ON parcels(vendor_id,order_number DESC,id DESC)

scenarios.name: returnHistory
scenarios.beforeSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT h.parcel_id) FROM parcel_status_history h JOIN parcels p ON p.id=h.parcel_id WHERE h.new_status::text='returned_to_vendor' AND h.created_at >= $1::timestamptz AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
scenarios.afterSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT h.parcel_id) FROM parcel_status_history h JOIN parcels p ON p.id=h.parcel_id WHERE h.new_status='returned_to_vendor'::parcel_status AND h.created_at >= $1::timestamptz AND p.deleted_at IS NULL

scenarios.afterSql: SELECT settlement_id FROM settlement_items WHERE cod_collection_id=$1 ORDER BY settlement_id
